name: io.github.Nerzal/gocloak-mcp
title: GoCloak MCP
description: Security-first, read-only Keycloak MCP server built in Go with GoCloak v15.

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS Keycloak base URL (loopback HTTP allowed for local development)

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_REALM
environmentVariables.description: Default target realm and token-issuing realm

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_ALLOWED_REALMS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of queryable realms
